query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ownerOpenId LIKE 'buyer-%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as buyer_animals,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ownerOpenId = 'jP5iBYMcdYguBWJPw5Sruu' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as owner_animals
FROM animals;
